name: zinput_bindmap_context_dispatch_mouse_button_callbacks
description: zInput_BindMapContext::DispatchMouseButtonCallbacks invokes command callbacks for mouse buttons whose transition state is pressed.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly checks button1, button2, and button3 transition fields for pressed state 1, maps each slot through GetCommandByMouseSlot, skips null callbacks, and indirect-calls non-null command callbacks.
Binary Ninja assembly passes commandId in ECX to zInputCommandCallbackFn for each non-null callback.
